june_cs: Onboarding LeafHealth mobile app — they see bursts of 401s immediately followed by 429s when many users launch the app. Happens after we pushed the mobile SDK.
leo_mobile: Any auth flow differences? are they using ephemeral tokens or long-lived keys?
june_cs: They opted for ephemeral tokens via our auth proxy. Refreshes come from their backend every 10s during load tests.
harper_support: I pulled edge logs: token validate fails with `invalid signature` on some requests, others succeed. Pattern: failing requests often have mTLS client cert present.
tom_infra: If their proxy is doing mutual TLS to our edge, and they also attach Authorization header from a different source (like a stale token from the native keychain), we can see signature mismatch. Maybe race between using cached token and fresh token after refresh.
leo_mobile: Could be token race + parallel startup in the SDK. Mobile brings up multiple workers that all try to refresh at once. Some hit the new token endpoint, others use cached value => mixed validity.
harper_support: Also observed spikes of `429 Too Many Requests` from our rate limiter immediately after the token churn. Clients are retrying aggressively with no jitter.
june_cs: Customer asks for minimal patch. They prefer a client fix first.
leo_mobile: Quick fixes: 1) SDK: add an in-memory refresh lock (per process) so only one refresh occurs; 2) use token version check: when refresh completes, publish new token to subscribers immediately; 3) on auth failure (401), if token age <10s, attempt single immediate refresh + retry once, otherwise surface error.
harper_support: Snippet for in-memory lock: 
``nlet refreshing = false; async function refresh(){
  if(refreshing) return await waitForToken();
  refreshing = true; try{ const t = await fetch('/auth/refresh'); publishToken(t); return t } finally{ refreshing = false }
}
``
Keep it tiny.
tom_infra: And add exponential backoff with random jitter for retries to avoid stampede. Suggest base 200ms, cap 8s.
june_cs: I'll send them the lock snippet + retry policy.
harper_support: Also added a temporary server-side tolerance: accept tokens with previous key for 30s grace to reduce 401s during turnover. Logged under ticket LH-2331.
infra-bot: [deploy] auth-proxy v1.12 staged at 4951230150 - grace-window toggled ON for staging.
leo_mobile: After they apply SDK lock, ask them to run a ramp test and share logs; if 401s persist, we'll require a short sync to instrument token lifecycles.
june_cs: Scheduling a 15-min call tomorrow 09:30 PT if needed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
